name: lumis-scope-guard
description: Turns your project's Non-Goals into boundaries your coding agent is stopped at, not told about. When you run its init with your Non-Goals, it writes permissions.deny rules and PreToolUse/UserPromptSubmit hooks into the project's .claude/settings.json, the same hook into the Cursor, Codex CLI, Windsurf and Copilot configs, plus scripts/scope_guard.py, .lumis/, CONSTITUTION.md, sections in .cursorrules and CLAUDE.md, and a copy of the fingerprints in ~/.lumis/baselines; the hook then refuses the agent's edits to its own files. The plugin itself adds no hooks. Stdlib Python: no network access, no telemetry, no model.
